notes.title: 2.5 version
Visual changes
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

You may have noticed that there has been a difference in the game logo. We've had some changes in the game beyond that.

The series logo changed because I saw the need to adapt the same visual identity to all games from now on, and this way things can be more unified.

In the game, there was a difference in the icon besides the title screen.

But the most important change was the character Caos' sprites. I updated them to a version identical to his iteration in Order from Caos 2.

I hope you like the visual changes.

Until next time.

Renan Barreto
Game Dev
